verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a REST v3 API, webhooks, a Postman collection, a documentation MCP server and an llms.txt index, but nothing shows an official command-line interface for BILL Spend & Expense. These are API and documentation tools, not a CLI, so they earn no credit toward this story. A fintech platform could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies and the absence of evidence means none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
